The bug is clear: the loop starts at range(1, len(nums)), skipping the first element. That explains all failures:
- "1 2 3" -> sums 2+3=5
- "7" -> range(1,1) empty -> 0
- "-4 10 -1" -> sums 10 + -1 = 9
- "100 1" -> sums 1 = 1

Root cause: off-by-one in loop start index; skips nums[0].

input.text: Your range currently starts at index 1, which means the loop adds the second element through the last element and never visits index 0.
